notes: 39 Tamil Nadu Lok Sabha MPs (2024 general election). Party tally ECI-verified: DMK 22, INC 9, VCK 2, CPI 2, CPI(M) 2, IUML 1, MDMK 1 — the INDIA bloc won all 39 seats. Winner, vote share and margin from ECI PcResultGenJune2024 constituency pages (state code S22); turnout % from IndiaVotes compilation of ECI data. PRS MP Track legislative data covers 24-06-2024 to 13-08-2026; attendance is published only on individual PRS pages, so MPs sourced from the PRS state listing have attendance null. MPLADS per-MP figures are not published in publicly readable form, so all funds fields are null. Disclosure from myneta.info/ADR analyses of ECI affidavits; fields not retrieved are null, never estimated. Namakkal: ECI records the winner's party as DMK (KMDK candidate who contested on the DMK symbol). District lists are derived from the assembly segments of each constituency per the ECI Delimitation Order.
